headline: Record quarter drives higher full-year guidance
summary_short: MasTec's Q2 FY2026 revenue hit a quarterly record of $4,374M (+23.4% y/y), with diluted EPS of $1.65 (+51.4% y/y) and adjusted EBITDA margin up 100bps y/y to 8.8%.
summary_long: Revenue was a quarterly record $4,374M, +23.4% y/y, led by 43.4% y/y growth in the Clean Energy and Infrastructure segment. Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 100bps y/y to 8.8% on "solid execution." Net income rose to $130M (+51.7% y/y) and diluted EPS to $1.65 (+51.4% y/y), both Q2 records. 18-month backlog reached a record $21.4B, +30% y/y, led by 58% y/y growth in Clean Energy and Infrastructure. The company closed its acquisition of The Superior Group (electrical contracting, data-center infrastructure) during the quarter. MasTec raised full-year Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance to $9.30 (+42% y/y) and updated GAAP Diluted EPS guidance to $6.20; cash rose to $316M despite negative quarterly free cash flow of $(59)M.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites broad-based 23% y/y revenue growth and solid execution driving 100bps of adjusted EBITDA margin expansion, plus record 18-month backlog on strong Clean Energy and Infrastructure demand.
Clean Energy and Infrastructure segment revenue grew 43.4% y/y, the fastest of the four segments, consistent with the release's cited 58% y/y growth in that segment's backlog.
CEO attributes the 100bps y/y adjusted EBITDA margin gain to "solid execution" driving margin expansion; release gives no further cost or mix breakdown for this move.
Diluted share count rose only 0.4% y/y (78.87M vs 78.52M), so diluted EPS growth of 51% tracks net income growth of 62% almost directly, with the gap explained by non-controlling-interest allocation.
